summary: evals/corpora/injections.yaml, trigger.yaml, no_trigger.yaml and near_miss.yaml (33 cases, entry: tag) now seed via `snapshot:` from real, non-eval-residue rooms and real historical instants instead of an empty room. `expect`, `expected_output` and `metadata` are unchanged on every case; only where the context comes from moved.
details: injections.yaml (5 cases): anchored on three real rooms chosen for contrast -- two real multi-person rooms sharing one notebook (one notes- and standing-rich, the other with its own distinct standing on the same notebook) and one real single-person room (notes-poor on its own unit, but with real standing). All five still `expect: reply`, unchanged.

trigger.yaml (12 cases, all expect: reply): reuses the same three anchors. Engagement here is room-independent (nora.tag.is_tagged reads only the literal input) so expect: reply was never at risk from an empty room -- this conversion only gives the reply itself real context to work with. metadata.prefill_sufficient (10 true / 2 false) is carried verbatim and untouched: nothing in the live harness (evals/backbone.py, evals/rebuilt/entry.py, evals.scenarios.MeetsGrader) reads it, matching evals/rebuilt/domain.py's own metadata docstring ('Nothing grades that yet'); the only readers are the unrelated, older tests/offline_eval_harness.py / tests/offline_eval_evaluators.py pair, which does not drive this corpus.

no_trigger.yaml (12) and near_miss.yaml (4), both expect: no_reply/silence: seeded from the same real, relevance_gate-enabled multi-person room injections.yaml anchors on. Measured (not assumed): converting the room does NOT make silence a contested claim through entry: tag. The tag EntryPoint (evals/rebuilt/entry.py) never turns on [relevance_gate] enabled, so RelevanceGatePolicy is never wired into CompositePolicy for these cases regardless of the room's real policy; and even granting that flag, Dispatcher.on_message's relevance-gate branch only calls ParticipationTrigger.note_message, a synchronous bookkeeping call that spawns nothing into subject.deps.background, so settle() returns immediately with nothing to observe. The real Relevance Gate model call only runs off a separate periodic sweep that nothing in the eval subject's composition schedules. Every expect: no_reply/silence stays correct, now guaranteed by the entry point's own wiring rather than by default_policy() omitting relevance_gate.

Rooms and people are referred to structurally in every comment (a real multi-person room / a real single-person room / N notes / standing present) -- never by room label, roster, or content. The only identifying values in these files are the conversation_id strings inside snapshot: blocks, which is the mechanism itself.
tests/architecture/test_corpora_are_rehomed_not_rewritten.py stays green: its old/new comparison never reads a case's `snapshot:` key, so adding it changes nothing that pin checks.

No case's expect, expected_output or metadata was changed. Verified: `uv run python -c "from evals.scenarios import load_corpus; ..."` still reports injections=5, trigger=12, no_trigger=12, near_miss=4; tests/unit/test_eval_scenarios.py, tests/unit/test_eval_backbone.py and tests/architecture/ all pass.
